scripts.preview: doppler run --project the-pool-man --config prd -- opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy: doppler run --project the-pool-man --config prd -- opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.secrets:sync: doppler secrets get SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY --plain --project the-pool-man --config prd | wrangler secret put SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY && doppler secrets get BREVO_API_KEY --plain --project the-pool-man --config prd | wrangler secret put BREVO_API_KEY
